title: 1728: Fix issue of <Select/> control in Attribute Editor

issues.title: Possible issue with z-order for `<Select/>` control in Attribute Editor
issues.body:
I'm in this game:
http://localhost:3000/?wargame=wargame-l63jlces&access=rl650chc3

I click on `R1` asset, and plan turn form opens.  I can then click on `Edit attributes`.  If I try to change `Depth` I don't see the values presented.  But, the direction of the triangle does change - so I think the items are visible, but beneath the popup.

![screencast](https://i.gyazo.com/b6c40368128bca1fa9259241ffc83d63.gif)
